title: The owner's numbers on Today go through every member, plan, payment and check-in about 30 times each time they are worked out
what: To draw the small trend lines under 'Fees due' and 'Stopped coming', the Today numbers work out the whole dues list and the whole 'losing the habit' list once for every point on the line: 30 points for the default 30 days, plus one more each for the totals and the day before. Each time it runs through all members, all plans, all receipts and all check-ins again. A gym with 500 or more members has tens of thousands of check-ins a year, so this is dozens of full passes on the owner's phone every time Today opens or the gym's data changes. The opened tile's page does the same work again. Not timed on a real phone.
expected: Each list is gone through once and each day's figure is read from that one pass, so Today opens just as fast for a big gym as for a small one.
who: owners of big gyms on the Today screen
how_often: every time Today opens or the gym's data changes
fix_line: Work out the dues and stopped-coming lines in one pass over the data instead of one pass per day

items.reason: this area is the admin app's logic; no phone app start or workout screen here
